bullets.text: A powerful earthquake in Colombia has resulted in at least 180 deaths, with rescuers continuing efforts to find survivors trapped in collapsed buildings.
Ukraine's President Zelensky stated that Russia is using North Korean missiles in its strikes, citing an attack in Zaporizhzhia that killed seven people.
Lebanon's parliament has voted to abolish the death penalty, a move that would make it the first country in the Middle East to end capital punishment if approved by the cabinet.
The Coalition plans to announce a proposal today aimed at reducing Australia's migration intake to its lowest level since 2008.
A second individual has been identified as an alleged fake doctor in Melbourne's bayside region and has been prohibited from treating patients following a health watchdog investigation.
A man has been charged in South Australia after authorities discovered a cache of guns, other weapons, and counterfeit currency in his Adelaide residence.

China is tightening its control over Europe's automotive supply chain through acquisitions of local parts manufacturers, a move that is causing concern among EU officials amid resistance to Chinese exports.
Investors are making record short bets against global bonds, increasing the stakes for upcoming US inflation reports this week.
African countries are increasingly moving away from using the dollar, with the yuan and local currencies expected to benefit from this shift.
